meta.name: Tamizha Tamizha - Season 2
meta.description: Tamil Nadu’s favourite debate show is back in an all-new avatar, where trending topics are discussed to bring about meaningful conclusions.

videos.title: Episode 1 : Is it Worth Believing in Astrology?
videos.overview: Karu Pazhniappan initiates a debate with a group of astrologers and random people who consult such astrologers. He is all ears to the astrologers as they recount their stories.
